scope: Canonical post-H0.0 H0.1 planning coordinator on registry generation 70. It reconstructs the next checkpoint and prepares, but does not itself create, the fresh current-main C22 runtime child Work Order/branch.
required_outputs: Director-dispatched bounded C22 child Work Order
Fresh current-main C22 branch after dispatch
stop_conditions: H0.0 checkpoint is not canonically integrated
Canonical main movement is not audited after merge
Any runtime/domain change is attempted under this planning Work Order
C22 branch creation is attempted before Director dispatch
PC0 has an unresolved blocking RED
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first controlled runtime-development pilot.
Incorrect handoff could authorize runtime from stale main or bypass H0.0 evidence.
Recovery and exact-head evidence are checkpoint-critical.

design_brief.problem_statement: H0.0 R3 is verified terminal evidence, while the canonicalization candidate advanced the main-owned registry to generation 70. The canonical launcher needs a fresh generation-70 next-phase state without rewriting R3 or silently reusing the cancelled generation-69 planning attempt.
design_brief.current_behavior: R3 is terminal CHECKPOINT_PROPOSED. H0.1-R1 was correctly cancelled when registry generation changed during candidate construction.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Canonical Status/Plan/Resume select H0.1-R2, reconstruct generation 70 from Git only, report H0.1 as next, keep runtime workers at zero until Director dispatch, and preserve strict epoch identity.
alternatives_considered: Create fresh H0.1-R2 from the completed generation-70 control tree
design_brief.selected_design: Create H0.1-R2 on the generation-70 canonicalization tree; keep R3 historical and R1 cancelled; require a post-merge audit before Director dispatch and C22 child branch creation.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves fail-closed identity and creates a restart-safe canonical next state without pre-authorizing runtime.
expected_risks: Runtime worker authorized while Work Order is PLANNED
validation_plan: Run focused canonical handoff harness suite
Require Plan=H0.1 with zero runtime workers and FORBIDDEN_UNTIL_DISPATCH
After actual merge, record main audit before dispatch

notes: Planning coordinator only. Runtime branch creation is forbidden until canonical H0.0 integration, post-merge audit and Director dispatch.
